title: Page 29
transc:
Recd 730 am  Aquia Creek
Sept 1"  640 AM
For Halleck and McClellan every thing 
is progressing well I have just
recd notice that all has passed
Potomac Creek I have strong Cavalry
and Artillery force at Stafford C
H and think I will get
every thing here without any trouble
the report of strong force moving
on Fredksbg but I cant believe
it signed Burnside  thick here


Aquia Creek
Sept 1"  640 AM 
For Gen Fox I ought 
to have more Gunboats
here it is an
absolute necessity the Anacosta
has been in notified
and will be here
in a day or
two unless some thing
happens signed Burnside 73
